profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Your name is shown to teammates, in approvals and in the audit log.
profile.emailFixed: Your sign-in email cannot be changed here.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing your password signs out every other session.
password.googleOnly: You sign in with Google. Set a password to also sign in with email.
password.changed: Password changed. Other sessions were signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.statusOn: {count, plural, one {On. # recovery code left.} other {On. # recovery codes left.}}
twoFactor.statusOff: Off. Protect your account with a code from an authenticator app at every sign-in.
twoFactor.scan: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, 1Password, Authy…), then enter the 6-digit code it shows.
twoFactor.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
twoFactor.manualKey: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
twoFactor.recoveryIntro: Save these recovery codes somewhere safe. Each one signs you in once if you lose your authenticator. They are shown only now.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the interface for you. Without a choice, the workspace default (or your browser) is used.

stepUp.title: Confirm it's you
stepUp.description: This change gives an AI employee more power. Enter your password and a code from your authenticator app. The confirmation is valid for 10 minutes.
stepUp.needs2fa: Set up two-factor authentication in your account first.
